title: Internet and SIM cards in Zhangjiajie
text: A Chinese SIM from China Mobile or China Unicom at the airport is the best option - about 100 yuan for 10-20 GB over 30 days. eSIMs like Airalo work too. Install a VPN before arrival - Google, YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp are all blocked in China.

title: Hostels vs hotels in Zhangjiajie
text: Hostels (40-80 yuan per bed) offer a social atmosphere, shared kitchens and local hosts with free park tips. Hotels (150-400 yuan for 3-star) give peace, private bathrooms and often breakfast. Book early for peak season - July-August and Golden Week sell out fast.

title: Where to stay in Zhangjiajie - areas compared
text: Three main areas: Wulingyuan right at the park entrance (150-400 yuan, most convenient), Zhangjiajie city center near station and Tianmen cable car (100-300 yuan, better transit), or inside the park at Tianzi Mountain (300-600 yuan, sunrise on your doorstep).

title: Zhangjiajie on a budget - total cost
text: Zhangjiajie is among the most affordable top parks in the world. A realistic 4-day budget: accommodation 400-800 yuan, tickets 770 yuan, food 200-300 yuan, transport 100 yuan - about 1,500-2,000 yuan total. Hostels start at 40 yuan, solid 3-star hotels from 200 yuan.

title: Zhangjiajie for seniors - accessible routes
text: The park is more accessible than it looks thanks to elevators, cable cars and buses. Best routes: upper plateau via Bailong Elevator (flat paths between viewpoints), the first 2-3 km of Golden Whip Stream, and Tianmen with cable car plus escalator instead of 999 steps.
